## ARRAY<INTERVAL> set operations
# Source: observed BigQuery answers. DISTINCT set operations reject ARRAY
# columns, including arrays containing INTERVAL or STRUCT values; UNION ALL accepts them.

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT [INTERVAL 1 MONTH, NULL] AS a
  UNION DISTINCT SELECT [INTERVAL 30 DAY, NULL]
  UNION DISTINCT SELECT [INTERVAL 720 HOUR, NULL]
)
=> error: Type ARRAY is not supported in UNION DISTINCT operation

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT [INTERVAL 1 MONTH, NULL] AS a
  INTERSECT DISTINCT SELECT [INTERVAL 720 HOUR, NULL]
)
=> error: Type ARRAY is not supported in INTERSECT DISTINCT or EXCEPT DISTINCT operation

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT [INTERVAL 1 MONTH, NULL] AS a
  EXCEPT DISTINCT SELECT [INTERVAL 30 DAY, NULL]
)
=> error: Type ARRAY is not supported in INTERSECT DISTINCT or EXCEPT DISTINCT operation

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT [INTERVAL 1 DAY, INTERVAL 2 DAY] AS a
  UNION DISTINCT SELECT [INTERVAL 2 DAY, INTERVAL 1 DAY]
  UNION DISTINCT SELECT [INTERVAL 1 DAY]
  UNION DISTINCT SELECT [INTERVAL 1 DAY, NULL]
)
=> error: Type ARRAY is not supported in UNION DISTINCT operation

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<INTERVAL>) AS a
  UNION DISTINCT SELECT ARRAY<INTERVAL>[]
  UNION DISTINCT SELECT ARRAY<INTERVAL>[NULL]
  UNION DISTINCT SELECT CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<INTERVAL>)
)
=> error: Type ARRAY is not supported in UNION DISTINCT operation

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<INTERVAL>) AS a
  INTERSECT DISTINCT SELECT CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<INTERVAL>)
)
=> error: Type ARRAY is not supported in INTERSECT DISTINCT or EXCEPT DISTINCT operation

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT ARRAY<INTERVAL>[] AS a
  EXCEPT DISTINCT SELECT CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<INTERVAL>)
)
=> error: Type ARRAY is not supported in INTERSECT DISTINCT or EXCEPT DISTINCT operation

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT 1 AS n, [INTERVAL 1 MONTH] AS a
  UNION DISTINCT SELECT 2, [INTERVAL 30 DAY]
  UNION DISTINCT SELECT 1, [INTERVAL 720 HOUR]
)
=> error: Type ARRAY is not supported in UNION DISTINCT operation

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT [INTERVAL 1 MONTH] AS a UNION ALL SELECT [INTERVAL 30 DAY]
)
=> "2"

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT [STRUCT(INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS i, 7 AS n), NULL] AS a
  INTERSECT DISTINCT SELECT [STRUCT(INTERVAL 30 DAY AS i, 7 AS n), NULL]
)
=> error: Type ARRAY is not supported in INTERSECT DISTINCT or EXCEPT DISTINCT operation

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  SELECT [STRUCT(INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS i, 7 AS n)] AS a
  EXCEPT DISTINCT SELECT [STRUCT(INTERVAL 30 DAY AS i, 8 AS n)]
)
=> error: Type ARRAY is not supported in INTERSECT DISTINCT or EXCEPT DISTINCT operation

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
  (SELECT [INTERVAL 1 MONTH] AS a UNION ALL SELECT [INTERVAL 30 DAY])
  INTERSECT DISTINCT SELECT [INTERVAL 720 HOUR]
)
=> error: Type ARRAY is not supported in INTERSECT DISTINCT or EXCEPT DISTINCT operation

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(a) FROM (
  SELECT [INTERVAL 1 MONTH] AS a UNION DISTINCT SELECT [INTERVAL 30 DAY]
)
=> error: Type ARRAY is not supported in UNION DISTINCT operation

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(a) FROM (
  SELECT [INTERVAL 30 DAY] AS a UNION DISTINCT SELECT [INTERVAL 1 MONTH]
)
=> error: Type ARRAY is not supported in UNION DISTINCT operation

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(a) FROM (
  SELECT [INTERVAL 1 MONTH] AS a INTERSECT DISTINCT SELECT [INTERVAL 720 HOUR]
)
=> error: Type ARRAY is not supported in INTERSECT DISTINCT or EXCEPT DISTINCT operation

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(a) FROM (
  SELECT [INTERVAL 30 DAY] AS a EXCEPT DISTINCT SELECT [INTERVAL 1 DAY]
)
=> error: Type ARRAY is not supported in INTERSECT DISTINCT or EXCEPT DISTINCT operation
